record.field: Player grounds the ball in a controlled way over the opponents' goal line. WR totals include penalty tries; here log penalty tries as Penalty Try instead.
Try awarded by the referee rather than scored by a player. Team stat - leave Player # blank.
Conversion kick passes between the uprights and over the crossbar.
Conversion kick does not pass between the uprights and over the crossbar.
Penalty kick at goal passes between the uprights and over the crossbar.
Penalty kick at goal does not pass between the uprights and over the crossbar.
Drop goal passes between the uprights and over the crossbar.
Drop goal does not pass between the uprights and over the crossbar.
A try decision is referred to the TMO.
Player throws the ball, other than the throw-in to a lineout or scrum.
Pass made while being tackled, or by a player brought to ground who passes before a ruck forms.
Player with the ball who engages in contact with the opposition.

Team in possession at the start of the ruck keeps it when the ball leaves; or opponents concede a penalty/free kick; or the ruck is unplayable but retained by the team in possession. If advantage is brought back during the ruck and a FK/penalty/scrum is awarded, the ruck counts and the awarded team is deemed to have won it.

Team in possession at the start loses it when the ball leaves the ruck; or concedes a penalty/free kick; or the ruck is unplayable and a scrum goes to the opponents. (Rucks total on Match Summary = won + lost, both teams.)

Team in possession at the start keeps it when the ball leaves the maul; or opponents concede a penalty/free kick; or the maul is unplayable from a kick but retained by the team in possession. Advantage rules as for rucks.

Team in possession at the start loses it when the ball leaves the maul; or concedes a penalty/free kick; or the maul is unplayable and possession goes to the opponents. (Mauls total = won + lost, both teams.)
ASSUMPTION (not on the WR page): a player arrives at and joins a ruck (clean-out, support or jackal support). Log one row per arriving player with their Player #; Team = Opp for the opposition.
Defender who attempted and completed a tackle and went to ground as a result.
Defender who attempted and completed a tackle and stayed on their feet.
Defender fails to complete a tackle they could reasonably have been expected to make.
ASSUMPTION: a jackal attempt that wins the ball or a penalty. Log together with Jackle Attempt.
First arriving defender attempts to get hands on the ball after a tackle (WR 'Jackler / Jackle attempt'). Log every attempt.
A sequence of play in which the team in possession reaches five or more phases (phases = the rucks and mauls that follow the first phase).
A sequence of play in which the team in possession reaches seven or more phases.
Team enters the opposition 22 in control of the ball. Leaving and re-entering within the same possession is still one entry.

Any kick out of hand or from the ground in general play (WR: possession kicked in general play); excludes penalty kicks, free kicks, marks, drop goals, conversions and restarts. Always log Kick Meters with it.
Kick whose flight is significantly altered by contact with a player from the team not in possession. A charged-down drop kick is counted as a drop goal miss instead.
Kicking team regains possession from its kick (general play, kicked penalty or kicked free kick). WR total also adds own restart regained (see Match Summary).
Any kick (general play, free kick, mark, penalty) caught or picked up by the other team, including a knock-on when trying to retain it that leads to an immediate scrum.
Referee stops the match for a knock-on.
Referee stops the match for a forward pass.
Team concedes an accidental offside; opposition awarded a scrum.
Ball touches the referee; scrum to the team in possession.
Possession lost at the tackle, from an error, or from a general-play infringement.
Scrum on own feed. Count once - a reset scrum is not an additional scrum.
Ball channelled to the back of the feeding team's scrum and play resumes (still won if the No.8 knocks on); or a penalty/free kick is awarded against the non-feeding team.
Ball goes beyond the opposition No.8's feet and they gain possession, or the scrum wheels more than 90 degrees; or a penalty/free kick is awarded against the feeding team.
One or both front rows (or front-row players) go to ground at engagement or during the scrum and do not immediately get up.
Referee orders an incomplete scrum to be reformed.
Scrum wheeled through more than 90 degrees; referee stops play and a new scrum is formed with the throw-in going to the team not in possession at the stoppage.
Lineout where own team throws in. Quick throw-ins are included.
Throw-in taken from the touchline before a lineout forms. Log it plus a Won/Lost row; it counts as an own line-out.

Team gains possession from the lineout (passed, tapped, retained, rucked or mauled); or non-throwing team concedes a penalty/free kick; or non-throwing team knocks on and a scrum is awarded. A quick throw won counts here.
Team loses possession from the lineout; or throwing team concedes a penalty/free kick; or throwing team knocks on and a scrum is awarded. A quick throw lost counts here.
Throw is not straight down the middle. WR counts this as a lost lineout: log this row INSTEAD of Own Line-out Lost (win % counts it as a loss).
Ball thrown in and the opposition contest in the air (e.g. lift a player for the ball).
Kick-offs at the start of each half and 50m restarts after scores. Not 22m drop-outs.
Kicking team regains possession from its restart, including when the receiving team knocks on and a scrum is awarded immediately. Not regained if the receivers concede a penalty/free kick.

Kick travels less than 10m, goes dead / dead in-goal, goes into touch on the full, players are in front of the kicker, or the kicker is over the line. Does not include knock-ons directly from the restart.
Penalty conceded at scrum. Pick the Offence Detail (binding, collapsing, engagement, handling, early detachment, standing up, boring in, feeding).
Penalty conceded at lineout. Offence Detail: barging, foul play, offside.
Penalty conceded in general play. Offence Detail: obstruction, not retreating 10m, deliberately knocking on, accidental offside, in front of kicker, other.
Penalty conceded at ruck or maul. Offence Detail: not staying on feet, handling in ruck, collapsing maul, entering from side, not rolling away, not releasing, obstruction.
Penalty to the non-offending team for foul play (gouging, punching, stamping, dangerous tackles, etc.).
Penalty conceded for offside (set piece / breakdown offside line, 10m at lineout, from a kick in general play).
Penalty kicked from hand. Excludes goal attempts and tapped penalties.
Scrum taken by a team that elected it after being awarded a penalty.
Penalty where a player tap-kicks the ball to himself/herself to restart.
Free kick to the non-offending team for an infringement at scrum.
Free kick for an infringement at lineout.
Free kick for an infringement in general play (not including marks).
Free kick for an infringement at ruck or maul.
Free kick kicked from hand, including a mark. Excludes tapped free kicks.
Scrum taken by a team that elected it after being awarded a free kick.
Free kick where a player tap-kicks the ball to himself/herself to restart.
Referee sends a player off for 10 minutes.
Player is sent off and takes no further part; team plays one short.
Second yellow card to a player, followed by a red card.
Match stops and the touch judge / assistant referee reports an incident to the referee.
Match stops so player(s) can receive medical treatment.
Player temporarily replaced for blood. Log two replacement events (out/in, then back).
Tactical replacement; a team may use up to 7 replacements.
